01

Working inside a team

Start with T-Bank. I worked on experiment configuration, pipelines and tools for analysts. The case explains the boundary between changing rules and application code, and why a processing result needs an explanation. My contribution and the wider team outcome are described separately.

02

Building across system boundaries

CODY connects a mobile interface, a local Bridge and actual sessions on a Mac. It lets me work across the architecture: context, protocol, state, failure and the user’s next step. The prototype shows decisions that extend beyond the implementation of one service.

03

A useful next conversation

My core experience includes Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Airflow and Kafka; projects also use FastAPI, Django/DRF, TypeScript and React Native. I am looking for a team where I can deepen my backend skills and discuss decisions with strong engineers. The CV gives the short account; the case studies provide concrete material for a technical conversation.
